review_description: Excellent customer services. Went above and beyond to inform me, answer all my questions and provide a tailored solution for the best possible long term outcome. Good price for high quality product and install. Was considerate of the layout and presentation aesthetics of the completed job.Excellent communication and follow up service.I would highly recommend Total Energy Solutions to anyone considering solar on the Mid North Coast.

We are very pleased with this company so far but as the system is not scheduled for installation yet we must reserve  our final judgement .However so far we have no issues of any concern.Service so far excellent.

We were not informed that we would need to upgrade our meter which has a further cost from Ergon of about $360. We have not had a bill since the system was installed. Also not sure if the meter we have would be working or not since we received the letter from Ergon last week.
